Kevin McGuan, Chair  Jacqueline Padilla-Perez, Commissioner
Mark Grisafe, Vice Chair  Marco Pizzo, Commissioner
Amy Bodek, Commissioner  Jocelynn Pryor, Commissioner
Tasha Hunter, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:01 PM, Chair McGuan called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Grisafe, McGuan

Commissioners Absent: Pryor

Also present: Christopher Koontz, Director of Community Development, Alison Spindler-Ruiz,
Planning Bureau Manager, Alejandro Sanchez-Lopez, Advanced Planning Officer,
Alejandro Plascencia, Planner, Felice Anaya, Clerk Typist, Nicholas Masero, Deputy City Attorney,
Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.

Chair McGuan spoke; and announced that Commissioner Pryor was excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Padilla-Perez led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-55938  Recommendation to receive and file Director’s Report.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Pizzo, seconded by Vice Chair Grisafe,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Grisafe, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Pryor

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development, spoke;
  and provided the Director’s Report.

  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Pryor

3.  25-55940  Recommendation to approve a Major Certificate of Appropriateness request to
  construct a one-story 822-square-foot addition to the rear of the main residence
  and located on the rear half of the lot. The property is located at 2081 Eucalyptus
  Avenue, within the Wrigley Historic District and the existing primary residence is a
  Contributing Structure to the district and in the R-1-N Zoning District. (District 7)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Pizzo, seconded by Commissioner
  Padilla-Perez, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  6  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Grisafe, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Pryor

  PowerPoint presentation.

  Christopher Koontz, Director of Community Development, spoke.

4.  25-55941  Recommendation to request City Council designate 149 Siena Drive (HLM25-01)
  as Historic Landmark building; and

  Request City Council approve Mills Act contracts for the following 13 properties:
  149 Siena Drive, 210 East Ocean Boulevard, 256 Lindero Avenue, 304 and 306
  Molino Avenue, 622 and 624 Orizaba Avenue, 807 Ohio Avenue, 2070 Eucalyptus
  Avenue, 2715 East 3rd Street, 3014 East 2nd Street, 3361 and 3363 East 1st
  Street, 3543 Myrtle Avenue, 3727 Gundry Avenue, and 3917 Long Beach
  Boulevard. (Districts 1, 2, 3, 5, and 7)

  A motion was made by Commissioner Padilla-Perez, seconded by Vice Chair
  Grisafe, to approve staff’s recommendations for Mills Act Contracts and a
  local landmark designation for City Council recommendation, and added by
  amendment a request for staff to present information at the next Cultural
  Heritage Commission meeting on giving the three Mills Act applicants - 3725
  Lime Avenue, 3596 Gundry Avenue, and 3733 and 3733 A California Avenue,
  that were not recommended for approval an opportunity to revise and expand
  their submission so as to meet the criteria for approval to be reconsidered by
  the Commission. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Grisafe, McGuan
